# TASK-021 Report job cadence

Status: cadence decided; implementation pending

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence set by the ruling cited below.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0002
  Path           docs/adr/0002-reports-go-out-weekly.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:aea104d89bfefcc20ddc7fc7f60dd30e6ec3b20116f46fbde8b28e8997782b06

## Cadence decision (2026-10-21)

Choose `daily`, at 07:00 shop time, under the current accepted ADR 0023.
Proceed with planning on that basis; no feature implementation is authorized by
this request. Do not commit, push, or merge changes in either repository.

The original handoff above is retained for traceability. At decision-log commit
`1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c` (also its current HEAD), ADR 0002's
file bytes hash to the cited digest, but its status is `Superseded by 0014`.
ADR 0014 is itself `Superseded by 0023`. All three use decision key
`report-cadence`; ADR 0023 is `Accepted` and replaces the 06:00 time in ADR 0014
with 07:00 while retaining the daily cadence. The original weekly ruling is
therefore no longer in force.

Current ruling relied on:

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions (local clone: ../mira-decisions)
  ADR            0023
  Path           docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:bea52c60547bd724a259f12e94614147bafc87856a3a4f0a9e28c339e0ce7366

This computed digest differs from the original handoff's cited digest because
it identifies the successor ruling's bytes, rather than ADR 0002's bytes.
The source in `src/report_job.js` remains unchanged; implementing this cadence
is future work.
